What works today (Phase 1)

Every button below maps to implemented, compiled and tested code — nothing fake.

DONE

AI chat, streaming

OpenAI-compatible chat-completions with SSE streaming, copy / share, conversation history in Room with search, and live status (Idle → Thinking → Streaming → Completed / Error).

DONE

Provider abstraction

OpenAI, OpenRouter, Gemini and Anthropic (OpenAI-compatible endpoints) plus a custom URL. Model and base URL configurable per provider.

DONE

Secure key storage

API keys live only in EncryptedSharedPreferences. Never hardcoded, never logged, removable from Settings at any time.

DONE

Project workspaces

Isolated app-private workspaces with safe create / delete and Zip-Slip-guarded ZIP import. Each project ships agent-context scaffolding.

DONE

Modern Android UI

Material 3 bottom navigation — Chat, Projects, Settings — with permission minimization (Internet only at runtime; mic / images / notifications requested on use).

DONE

Honest architecture

Modular packages (ai · data · security · projects · ui) ready for the agent engine, terminal, browser and build backends — without placeholder claims.

Install & first run

  1. Download the debug APK above onto your Android phone (ARM64, Android 8+).
  2. Open it and allow Install unknown apps for your browser when asked.
  3. Launch Personal Agent, go to Settings → Provider, pick a provider and paste your API key, then Save securely.
  4. Return to Chat and send your first message — the status line shows live progress.
  5. Create an isolated workspace under Projects for anything the agent should work on.

Roadmap

Shipped incrementally, compiling and launchable after every phase.

PHASE 2

Agent engine + terminal

Planner / executor / tool router with explicit permission boundaries, plus the in-app terminal on the sandboxed runtime.

PHASE 3

Importer + tool manager

GitHub / ZIP importer with real compatibility scanning, on-demand runtimes and storage management.

PHASE 4–6

Browser · builds · release

Agent browser, coding agent, “build me an APK” manager with remote-build backend, voice / vision / memory, Play Store hardening and billing flags.
